data.one_liner: Algorithmic Cognitive Complexity calculation and Data-Flow analysis library and CLI tools.
data.what_it_does: Calculates algorithmic Cognitive Complexity and analyzes statement data-flow, file decomposition, and shallow helpers for Dart and Flutter. Includes CLI tools, a GitHub Action, and an AI agent skill for automated code quality gates.
use_when: You want to enforce a maximum cognitive complexity threshold in your CI pipeline.
You need automated recommendations for splitting large files or safely extracting helper methods.
avoid_when: You are looking for traditional style-only linters that do not evaluate complexity or data-flow.
Your project uses a Dart SDK version older than 3.12.0.
strengths: Deterministic complexity engine without external LLM calls or token latency.
Includes data-flow analysis, acyclic file decomposition, and git diff analysis.
weaknesses: Requires a minimum Dart SDK version of 3.12.0.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml or run directly via `dart run cognitive_complexity`.
